# Claude Platform release notes — captured 2026-08-07
# Source used: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/api
# (platform.claude.com/docs/api/getting-started and /docs/build-with-claude/overview both still 404)

## August 5, 2026 [NEW — REPORTED]
- **Inference hooks (beta, Claude Enterprise)** — point Claude at your org's AI security server; each
  governed prompt across claude.ai, **Cowork**, and **Claude Code** is HELD for the server's allow/deny
  verdict before inference proceeds. Requests are signed; failure handling configurable; every denial
  recorded in the compliance Activity Feed.
- Claude Opus 4.1 (claude-opus-4-1-20250805) retired. [deprecation — not reportable]

## August 1, 2026 [NEW]
- Dreams (research preview) now supports Claude Opus 5.

## July 24, 2026 [NEW — REPORTED]
- **Claude Opus 5** (`claude-opus-5`) — 1M token context (default AND max), 128k max output, thinking on
  by default, $5/$25 per MTok. Available on Claude API, Claude in Amazon Bedrock, Claude on Google Cloud
  (Vertex), and Claude in Microsoft Foundry. Effort ladder low/medium/high/xhigh/max.
- **Mid-conversation tool changes (beta)** on Fable 5, Mythos 5, Opus 4.8, Opus 5 — add or remove tools
  between turns while preserving the prompt cache. Header: mid-conversation-tool-changes-2026-07-01.
- `fallbacks` parameter gains a `"default"` mode (Anthropic-recommended fallback models by refusal
  category). Server-side fallback beta; header server-side-fallback-2026-07-01.
- Fast mode removed for Claude Opus 4.7. [deprecation]

## July 22, 2026 [NEW — REPORTED]
- Claude Managed Agents: `effort` settable on an agent's model config.
- **Managed Agents webhooks extended to environment and memory-store lifecycle** — four `environment.*`
  and three `memory_store.*` event types.
- Sessions can be seeded with `initial_events` on POST /v1/sessions (up to 50 user.message /
  user.define_outcome events); a non-empty list starts the agent loop in the same call.
- `version` now optional when updating an agent (optimistic concurrency).
- Session THREAD event streams support event deltas (subagent text previewed as generated).

## July 17, 2026
- Legacy Workbench sunset Aug 17, 2026; experimental prompt tools APIs
  (/v1/experimental/{generate,improve,templatize}_prompt) retired with it. [deprecation]

## July 15, 2026
- Mid-conversation system messages available on Fable 5, Mythos 5, Opus 4.8 (API, Bedrock, Vertex);
  no beta header. (availability correction)

## July 14, 2026 [NEW — REPORTED]
- **Claude Enterprise user management via the Admin API (beta)** — list members, look up by email,
  change roles, remove members, send/withdraw invites, manage groups and membership, read custom roles.
  Groups + custom roles need header ce-user-management-2026-07-13. Admin API key with `read:org_audit`
  can call every user-management GET.

## July 10, 2026
- Dreams supports Fable 5 and Sonnet 5. Access Transparency `cmek_preserve` docs expanded with two
  preservation reason codes (policy_violation_investigation, csae_report).

## July 8, 2026
- API key / Admin API key EXPIRATION at creation; Admin API reports `expires_at`. [below bar this scan]

## July 2, 2026
- New `agent-memory-2026-07-22` beta header changes memory-store list semantics; SDKs updated.

## July 1, 2026
- Access restored to Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5.

## June 30 and earlier [pre-window; Sonnet 5 already reported 2026-07-03]
- Claude Sonnet 5 launch; Managed Agents event deltas / backward pagination / per-session agent
  overrides / vault credential `injection_location`; agent+deployment webhooks; MCP tunnels moved to
  /v1/tunnels (mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22).

## COVERAGE-GAP RECOVERY (pre-existing, never reported by this monitor)
- **Dreams** (research preview, beta header dreaming-2026-04-21, live since ~Apr 2026):
  POST /v1/dreams — async job over 1 memory store + 1..100 session transcripts producing a NEW
  derived memory store. Resource IDs drm_01...; statuses pending/running/completed/failed/canceled;
  list/cancel/archive endpoints; runnable on claude-opus-5, fable-5, opus-4-8, opus-4-7, sonnet-5,
  sonnet-4-6. [REPORTED 2026-08-07 as backlog recovery]
- **Claude Cowork** (launched Jan 12, 2026 on macOS; web + mobile since July 2026): autonomous
  desktop agent that reads/writes LOCAL files in user-designated folders; same agentic architecture as
  Claude Code; cloud task execution in beta. [REPORTED 2026-08-07 as backlog recovery]

Updated: 2026-08-07 — Large delta vs the 2026-07-08 cache (30-day gap). Seven reportable items plus
two backlog recoveries.
